preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(o1 % 2 == 1 and o2 % 2 == 1 and o1 >= 1 and o2 >= 1 for o1, o2 in testcases)
preconditions.description: For every test case, o1 and o2 are odd positive integers.

preconditions.expression: all(all(d in (0, 1) for d in districts) for _, _, districts in testcases)
preconditions.description: Every district representative value is either 0 or 1.

preconditions.expression: all(len(districts) == o1 * o2 for o1, o2, districts in testcases)
preconditions.description: The number of district values equals o1 * o2 for each test case.

preconditions.expression: sum(o1 * o2 for o1, o2, _ in testcases) <= 10**6
preconditions.description: The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 10^6.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(line in ('0', '1') for line in stdout_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is either '0' or '1'.

postconditions.expression: all((1 if (any(all(sum(districts[(start + k) % N] for k in range(o2)) > o2 // 2 for start in range(0, N, o2)) > o1 // 2) else 0) == int(stdout_lines[i]) for i, (o1, o2, districts) in enumerate(testcases))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is 1 if there exists a partition of the circular districts into o1 consecutive blocks of size o2 such that the number of blocks with a majority of Ones is greater than o1/2; otherwise the output is 0.
